name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 20, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Exodus Recovery, Inc. Program Director Megan Patrick-Thompson on the North Coastal Mobile Crisis Response Team
2021-10-20 Item 04A North Coast Mobile Crisis Response Team Presentation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants.
2021-10-20 Item 08A Approval of Warrants List
8B.
Contract for Dredging and Grading of the Cottonwood Creek Detention Basin. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
1) City Council authorizes the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 for dredging and grading of the Cottonwood Creek detention basin between the City of Encinitas and Entenman Development Group, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $224,900 with a ten percent contingency in the amount of $22,490 for a project total not to exceed amount of $247,390 ; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2021-92 Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-10-20 Item 08B Cottonwood Creek Dredging Contract
8C.
Treasurer’s Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2021, and Investment Policy. Contact Person: Finance Director McBroome
1) Receive and file the Treasurer’s Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2021; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-103 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Statement of Investment Policy for the Fiscal Year 2021-2022 and Delegating the Authority to Invest City Funds to the Treasurer” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-10-20 Item 08C Annual Investment Report and Investment Policy
8D.
New 2022 Major Special Event Requests. Contact Person: Management Analyst Gilliam
1) Approve the first year of the new major special event, the Encinitas Half Marathon (Half Marathon, 5K, and Kid’s “K”) to be held on Sunday, March 27, 2022 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Approve the first year of the new major special event, the Moonlight Beach Fun Run (10K, 5K, and Kid’s “K”) to be held on Sunday, October 23, 2022 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) pending Marine Safety’s assessment of sand conditions closer to the event date.
2021-10-20 Item 08D 2022 Major Special Event Requests
8E.
Amendment No. 1 to the July 1, 2021, MOU between the City of Encinitas and San Diego County Bicycle Coalition to provide City Cycling courses at the Encinitas Community Center. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Stayton
Approve and authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in substantial form, as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, between the City of Encinitas and San Diego County Bicycle Coalition to provide additional City Cycling courses at the Encinitas Community Center.
2021-10-20 Item 08E Amendment to MOU San Diego Bike Coalition
8F.
Approve Three As-Needed Project Management and Engineering Services Agreements. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute professional services agreements in substantial form as shown in Attachments 1-3 of the agenda report, and any necessary time extensions, with Project Partners, Ardurra (IEC) and Villa Civil. Each contract will be for a total not to exceed amount of $250,000 for As-Needed Project Management and Engineering Services, providing a total capacity of $750,000.
2021-10-20 Item 08F As Needed Project Management Agreements
8G.
Proposed Mural at the Encinitas Library by Artist Kevin Anderson. Contact Person: Director of Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Karlen
Staff is recommending to the City Council to review the recommendation by the Commission for the Arts, vote to approve the proposed mural, and accept the donation of artwork to the City.
2021-10-20 Item 08G Mural Proposal Agenda Report
8H.
Youth Commission Work Plan Outcomes for Fiscal Year 2020-21 and Proposed Work Plan for Fiscal Year 2021-22. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Supervisor Anderson
1) Receive final report outcomes for the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Youth Commission Work Plan (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Approved the proposed Fiscal Year 2021-22 Youth Commission Work Plan (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-10-20 Item 08H Youth Commission Work Plan
8I.
Coastal Program Grant from the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service to support the installation and monitoring of the Beacon’s Coastal Bluff Restoration Project (Project). Contact Person: Coastal Zone Program Administrator Timberlake
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to accept the grant and negotiate and execute any necessary documents to comply with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) grant requirements (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment No. 2 in substantial form as included in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, with Habitat Restoration Sciences, Inc. (HRS) in the amount of $49,600 plus 10% contingency ($4,960), for an agreement amendment amount of $49,600 and an agreement not to exceed amount of $147,060. The project total not to exceed amount is $152,020; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-97, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget” to transfer funding to the Beacon’s Coastal Bluff Restoration Project (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).
2021-10-20 Item 08I Beacons USFWS Grant
8J.
Introduction of Ordinance 2021-21 establishing a new speed limit on Via Cantebria. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Barr
Introduce Ordinance 2021-21, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limit on Via Cantebria,” establishing a new speed limit of 25 mph on Via Cantebria between Garden View Road and Town Center Drive (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-10-20 Item 08J Via Cantebria Speed Limit Ordinance Intro
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission’s denial of a Design Review Permit (DR) and Coastal Development Permit (CDP) to allow for the demolition of an existing unit and the reconstruction of a new unit and associated improvements to an existing five-unit complex. CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003486-2019; DR-003487-2019; CDPNF-003488-2019; APPLICANT: Randy and Toni Popien; APPELLANT: Randy and Toni Popien; LOCATION: 1222, 1224, 1226, 1228, and 1230 Hermes Avenue (APN: 254-253-06). Contact Person: Associate Planner Mireau
Approve the appeal, set aside the decision of the Planning Commission, and adopt the Draft Resolution No. 2021-102 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) with findings to approve the project.
2021-10-20 Item 10A Popien Appeal - Agenda Report
2021-10-20 Item 10A Popien Appeal - Attachment 01 - Draft Resolution 2021-102
2021-10-20 Item 10A Popien Appeal - Attachment 02 - Draft Resolution 2021-100
2021-10-20 Item 10A Popien Appeal - Attachment 03 - PC Res 2021-30
2021-10-20 Item 10A Popien Appeal - Attachment 04 - PC Agenda Report 08052021
2021-10-20 Item 10A Popien Appeal - Attachment 05 - Appeal Filed by Toni Popien 08192021
10B.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2021-94, establishing cannabis business registration, application, and other regulatory fees related to implementation of the voter-approved Ordinance No. 2020-18 (Measure H) regulating commercial cannabis activity. Additionally, an update is provided on City Council direction regarding public outreach, odor management, procedures for filing complaints, signage, and other topics. Contact Person: Associate Planner Jedynak
Adopt Resolution No. 2021-94 titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Establishing Cannabis Business Registration, Application, and other Regulatory Fees" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-10-20 Item 10B Cannabis Fee Study and Fees Adoption
2021-10-20 Item 10B Cannabist Fee Study and Fees Adoption - Public Comments Received by 3PM on 102021
2021-10-20 Item 10B Cannabis Fee Study and Fees Adoption - Staff Presentation
2021-10-20 Item 10B Cannabis Fee Study and Fees Adoption - HDL Presentation
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Encinitas Pacific View Assessment Report. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Campbell
Receive the oral presentation.
2021-10-20 Item 11A Encinitas Pacific View Assement Report - Staff Presentation
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Mayor Blakespear requesting Council approval of an Offshore Oil Drilling Resolution.
City Council approve Resolution 2021-105, titled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas in support of the American Coasts and Oceans Protection Act.”
2021-10-20 Item 12A City Council Initiated Item - Oil Spill Resolution
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 27, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
